spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the feature's stated motivation (chromestatus: linear spaces for physical-light rendering) with the real surface — getContext('2d', {colorSpace:'srgb-linear'}) scratch canvases, cross-space getImageData readbacks — and honestly documents the measured non-difference (gradient stop interpolation is unchanged by the backing store) instead of overclaiming.

interactive.rationale: An alpha slider redraws both stores live with pixel readbacks per panel, and a second button runs the additive 'lighter' comparison; every number shown is either a real readback or explicitly labelled computed reference.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises the two compositing operations side-by-side with readbacks and brighter linear results, which is what the page runs (and what was measured: 187,188,0 vs 127,128,0 at 50%).

edge_cases.rationale: Unsupported browsers get an honestly empty linear panel with the browser's verbatim TypeError, exact flag steps, and computed-reference numbers labelled as computed — never a faked linear rendering; slider endpoints (0%/100%) are called out as the agree-exactly case.

references.rationale: See-also links chromestatus.com/feature/5122501071994880, the spec's colour-space section, and the transfer-function sibling page.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's context/getImageData srgb-linear readback assertions cover this page's primary surface; the page adds no claims beyond them plus clearly-labelled computed references.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: slider and both buttons driven at 1280×2000 and 360×1600; sRGB panel drew with readback rgb(127,128,0) at 50% and clipped white for 'lighter'; the linear panel showed the unsupported fallback with the real TypeError; behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features the real linear readbacks were reproduced (187,188,0 blend; 176,176,176 lighter) matching the page's computed references; zero console errors; post-interaction screenshots read on both classes.

telemetry_health.rationale: Real-readback branches assert blend-linear-real-readback / lighter-linear-real-readback with the pixel data; the unsupported branch asserts *-unsupported-fallback with the browser's error detail, never a fake pass.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons keep background+color together with focus-visible rings; panels auto-fit to one column on narrow viewports; canvases are max-width 100%.

accessibility.rationale: Canvases carry role=img with descriptive aria-labels, every pixel value is mirrored as visible text readouts, the primary outcome lands in aria-live outputs, the slider is a labelled native range input with aria-describedby to the result.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360×1600 DPR3 and 1280×2000: panels stack to one column, no horizontal overflow, 44px controls, same real/fallback behaviour on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Add a real linear-store screenshot pair to the copy once a 155 build drives the page
openQuestions.detail: On a browser with the feature the two panels differ visibly (brighter blend, unclipped grey). The page proves it with readbacks; when the harness gains a 155+ binary, capture the supported-state screenshots for the evidence trail and confirm the brighter-light summary sentence renders from real data.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Canvas output needs text equivalents: role=img labels plus text readouts and live-region announcements for state changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both canvas pairs have role=img aria-labels and per-panel text readbacks; outcomes are announced via output[aria-live=polite].

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use auto-fit grid with min() clamps so side-by-side panels collapse to one column on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The .pair grid uses repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(240px,100%),1fr)); measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: range slider labelling and immediate feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label sliders with their current value visibly and update results on input, not only on a separate submit.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The alpha slider shows its live percentage in the label and redraws both panels on every input event, with a button alternative.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP interaction run: readouts changed on slider input

summary: Practical angle: compositing in a linear store mixes light instead of code values. Both operations run for real where the space exists, degrade to a verbatim-TypeError fallback plus labelled computed references where it does not, and the copy records the measured boundary of the feature (gradient interpolation unchanged) so the page cannot overclaim.
